high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from "The News Minute," a news website. The headline and main content of the article discuss the arrest of drug peddlers. The arrested individuals are identified as Nabaran Chakma from Assam, along with his associates Mobin Babu, Roland Rodney Rozer (a foreigner), and Tarun Kumar Lalchand. The article mentions that the gang operated from an apartment called Elite Ashwini for three years, evading the police department.
